items.title: Tim Hortons South Side Shuffle – The 28th Annual Port Credit Blues and Jazz Festival
items.summary: The 28th Annual Tim Hortons Southside Shuffle is a non-profit, award-winning blues and jazz festival held in Port Credit, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, September 11–13, 2026. The three-day outdoor festival features three stages at Port Credit Memorial Park, presenting 60 bands from across Canada and beyond, including over 20 local acts during its Saturday afternoon street party.

items.title: Philippine Festival Mississauga
items.summary: Experience the vibrancy of Filipino heritage through a full day of music, dance, and unforgettable flavours. This lively festival brings the spirit of the Philippines to life with performances, cultural showcases, and a welcoming atmosphere for all. Enjoy live entertainment, traditional and modern dance, and a variety of authentic Filipino cuisine. Browse local vendors, discover unique crafts, and connect with a community proud to share its culture and traditions.

items.title: Mississauga Parkinson Canada SuperWalk
items.summary: C. Saddington Park for a community event raising awareness and support for people living with Parkinson’s disease and their families. This family-friendly walk welcomes participants of all ages and abilities to come together, connect with the community, and make a difference. SuperWalk events support Parkinson Canada’s programs, services, advocacy efforts, and research initiatives. Admission is free, however, online registration prior to the event is preferred.

items.title: Mississauga Literary Festival
items.summary: Celebrate the culture of reading and writing in Mississauga. Visitors can enjoy Mississauga’s annual literary festival, featuring engaging panel discussions, interactive writing workshops, book-themed activities, local author showcases, a special keynote Author Talk, and plenty more to discover. This is a drop-in event, but registering will ensure attendees receive updates leading up to the Mississauga Literary Festival. Program details and exhibitor information will be available in mid-August.

items.title: Streetsville's 6th Annual Fall Market
items.summary: Streetsville's 6th Annual Fall Market, a vibrant event for all local residents and visitors, celebrating the autumn season! Get ready for a day of fun, live music, treats, and fantastic finds. On Saturday, September 12, 2026 , starting at 12:00 PM , we invite you to indulge in a day filled with local flavors, arts, crafts, and community spirit. Shop local vendors, enjoy music, kids' activities and free face painting from 12pm-7pm.

items.summary: Discover how compost can transform your garden in this practical, hands-on workshop focused on building healthy soil from the ground up.

items.title: AfroCan Roots & Rhythms Festival 2026
items.summary: Celebrate the richness and diversity of African and Caribbean culture at this vibrant, high-energy festival. From powerful live performances to music that moves you, this is a full-sensory experience rooted in heritage, community, and expression. Expect live music, cultural showcases, dynamic dance performances, and a lineup of artists bringing the sounds of Afrobeats, reggae, dancehall, and more to life. Explore authentic cuisine, support local vendors, and connect with a community that celebrates culture in every form.

items.title: International Observe the Moon Night
items.summary: International Observe the Moon Night is a worldwide public event that encourages observation, appreciation and understanding of our Moon.
